meta.conventions: origin at the centre of the free face; z into the layer; u_z>0 = indentation
meta.layer: infinite layer of thickness t perfectly bonded to a rigid base (exact Green function)
meta.accuracy_note: rel_err_est: Fredholm = |K(N/2)-K(N)|/K; ring/rect BEM = Richardson extrapolation distance from the finest mesh; maps = change between the two finest meshes and between two Fourier resolutions

halfspace_formulas.boussinesq_uz: (1-nu)/(2 pi mu r) per unit normal force
halfspace_formulas.hertz: F = (4/3) E/(1-nu^2) R^1/2 delta^3/2, a = sqrt(R delta)

bonded_noslip.method: ring BEM (p, q_r piecewise const.), sine-graded, Richardson over n=100..800
ring BEM (p, q_r piecewise const.), sine-graded, Richardson over n=100..800

R=10mm.method: Fredholm 2nd kind (Nystrom N=48), contact radius from g(a)=0 by root finding at each delta
R=10mm.winkler_note: Winkler k=M/t: F = k pi R delta^2 (labelled comparison only)

ring_BEM_active_set_check.note: ring width 1.3a/600 limits the contact-radius resolution

R=25mm.method: Fredholm 2nd kind (Nystrom N=48), contact radius from g(a)=0 by root finding at each delta
R=25mm.winkler_note: Winkler k=M/t: F = k pi R delta^2 (labelled comparison only)

ring_BEM_active_set_check.note: ring width 1.3a/600 limits the contact-radius resolution

frictionless.method: rectangular BEM, piecewise-constant tractions, sine-graded quarter mesh n x n, collocation at element centres; half-space closed form + exact layer correction; Richardson over n

taxel_maps.index_order: [i][j][component], i = 0..4 along x, j = 0..6 along y, component (x, y, z); centre taxel (2,3)
taxel_maps.surface_contact_force_note: exact: all contact elements lie inside taxel (2,3); in-plane components sum to 0 by symmetry. (The Fourier-series value differs by up to the Ng-change listed in accuracy because the 1/sqrt edge singularity sits exactly on the taxel border.)

profiles_per_delta.note: u/delta along y=0 and x=0; under the punch the BEM collocation error is visible as small wiggles near the edge
